thread:
jordan: FYI incoming support ticket from @AcmeCorp — they see invalid JSON coming back from /v1/chat and billing spiked ~3x due to repeated client retries. sending initial logs and sample response.

jordan: log snippet:
```
WARN parsed_output: invalid_json request_id=rc-9876 model=gptx-2 latency_ms=312 tokens=423 retries=3
```

sophia: Can you paste the account id + the exact response they got? Also confirm if they had structured_output.mode=strict enabled :thinking: 

jordan: account: acct_8492. They had structured_output: {"mode":"strict","json_schema":"customer_event"} — sample response from model (malformed):
```
{"event":"purchase","amount":49.99 "currency":"USD"}
Note: missing comma and then some trailing commentary: "
```

sophia: ugh. thanks. that trailing commentary explains the parse fail.

eli: ops alert fired for structured_output.parse_retries high for acct_8492 — alert SO-2023. Grafana panels show a spike starting 2024-06-20 14:05 UTC. Metrics to look at: `structured_output.parse_failures`, `structured_output.parse_retries`, `billing.tokens_consumed`, `model.latency_p95`. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/so-summary

ops-bot: ALERT: rule s_output_retries triggered at 1716203340 — threshold > 0.1 retries/s for 5m (affected: acct_8492).

maya: My guess: schema drift + a prompt tweak on their side introduced a free-text "metadata" field, model sometimes appends an explanatory sentence after json. In strict mode we reject and client retries. Two quick mitigation ideas: (a) add a sanitizer rule to strip trailing non-json tokens, (b) advise customer to use `fallback":"loose"` so we return best-effort instead of failing and causing retries.

samir: repro steps to reproduce locally:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"input":"Create an event JSON","structured_output":{"mode":"strict","json_schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"event\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"amount\":{\"type\":\"number\"}}}"}}'
```
This reproduces the trailing commentary case for gptx-2 with our current template.

eli: Observability actions: enable 1% sampling traces for acct_8492 to capture token-level emits and parse boundaries (will include kv-cache snapshots). Add `trace_id` to support ticket when done. I also created a temporary alert rule to surface `billing.tokens_consumed` deltas when `parse_retries` > 0.5x baseline.

maya: Eng-ML action: add a sanitizer that strips any characters after the first balanced top-level JSON object and log sanitizer hits to `structured_output.sanitizer_hits`. Also consider soft-failure where we attempt to auto-fix simple syntax errors (missing comma) before rejecting.

eli: Infra/ops action: please throttle automatic client-side retry footguns by adding a short retry-backoff suggestion in the 4xx payload when strict mode fails (e.g., `retry_after_ms` and `suggested_mode=loose`). That should reduce immediate billing spikes.

sophia: Action items for support: (1) ask customer to enable fallback=loose while we investigate, (2) request permission to attach traces and repro logs, (3) share short-term mitigations. Assignments: eli (traces/alerts), maya (sanitizer + soft-fix), ops infra (retry payload change), jordan (customer comms).

jordan: I'll send the customer the fallback suggestion and request trace access now. will post trace id here when available. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

eli: noted. creating a follow-up ticket ENG-1249 to track sanitizer + payload changes. linking it to the support ticket.

ops-bot: NOTE: temporary dashboard created -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/so-temp/acct_8492 (retention 48h).

jordan: trace id shared: trace-0x3fa7c. adding to support ticket. will keep thread updated.
